info.title: kickNX
info.author: j2k
info.description: Kick streaming client for Nintendo Switch
info.details: kickNX is an independent Kick client built specifically for the Nintendo Switch. It brings livestream viewing, category discovery, search, and integrated chat interaction to handheld, tabletop, and docked play.

changelog:
v0.5.2
kickNX v0.5.2

 Added
- Daily Reward bar: while you watch a live stream signed in, a bar above chat shows your progress toward Kick's daily watch reward, counting up smoothly. When it is full, press the right stick to claim it and see the collectible you got.
- Gift button on Home: a small window with your daily reward progress, a Claim button when it is ready, or the time until it resets.
- Emote tabs: Recent, Channel, Global and Collectibles, in landscape and portrait. Animated collectible emotes now animate in chat.
- Subscriber emotes- in the Channel tab when Kick confirms you are subscribed.
- Stream thumbnails for followed channels: live followed cards show the stream's thumbnail instead of the streamer's profile picture.
- Count watch time for rewards: a Player Settings switch to turn watch time reporting off.

 Changed
- Watch time check-ins: kickNX reports watch time in a brief check-in every 2 minutes instead of holding a connection open for the whole stream.
- Fewer connections for chat, and emote lists are kept for ten minutes per channel.

 Fixed
- Wi-Fi drops: chat reconnect loops, buffering and "Couldn't resolve host" errors that often needed Airplane mode to clear. kickNX now asks the Switch to keep its internet connection, as games do, and waits out brief drops instead of failing.
- Channel emotes missing- after the Switch sat idle or after switching channels.
- Emote pictures turning into text- after watching several channels.
- SSL errors and buffering when sending- chat messages.
- Stretched thumbnails- on stream and clip cards, blurry live event cards, and cropped offline profile pictures.

> [!TIP]
> Full RAM Mode Recommended:- For the best performance and 60 FPS playback stability, launch the Homebrew Menu by holding the R- button while launching any installed game (title override), rather than launching through the Album. Will not run in applet mode.

 Install
Install from the Homebrew App Store, or download kickNX-0.5.2.zip and copy its switch folder to the root of your SD card (or copy kickNX.nro to /switch/kickNX/kickNX.nro). Already on 0.5.1? Use About → Check for updates.

 Disclaimer & Notice
kickNX is an independent open-source project distributed under the GPL-3.0- license. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Kick Streaming Pty Ltd or Nintendo.

v0.5.1
- Rewind a live stream back to its start: longer rewinds switch to the live VOD, with chat staying live
- Still-live broadcasts show as a LIVE now card on streamer pages
- Check for updates now installs the new version and restarts kickNX
- Scrub label over the progress bar and a larger live buffer (about 30 seconds)
- Live viewer counts on category and event cards
- Help screens when kickNX is opened from the Album
- Notes for text the Switch fonts cannot draw
- Faster Home and chat, and a fix for a crash after scrubbing

v0.5.0
- Colour themes: OLED, Dark Grey and Kick, chosen from the Theme button on Home
- Live events row with event pages showing live streams and popular clips
- In-app on-screen chat keyboard in landscape, with an Emotes key
- Hold A on the progress bar and use the left stick or D-pad to scrub
- Check for updates button on the About page
- Kick-only client: Jellyfin, media library and other non-Kick features removed
- Offline streams return to the previous screen automatically
- Right-stick scrolling and touch-to-controller fixes
- Fixes for SSL connect errors, a crash after closing a stream quickly, and a damaged settings file

v0.4.0
Initial release of kickNX for Nintendo Switch.
